text:
QUOTE: "a repo's own `index_scope:` declaration is the only thing that decides the scope. If nothing is declared, clew indexes the whole repository"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer does not say that every failure to find one falls through to whole-repo; it describes rejected declarations as still falling to whole-repo but frames the declared scope as the sole decider, and says nothing of other failure modes such as unreadable files.
